issues.jp_before: 熱[ねつ]{が|ga-sub-clause}{さがったら/さがれば|tara-conditional}、また来[き]てください。
issues.problem: Odd scenario: you would be asked to come back if the fever does not go down, not once it has.
issues.action: Rewrote the main clause as permission to go to school, and added さがるなら as a second distractor.

issues.jp_before: もっと勉強[べんきょう]{すれば/したら|ba-conditional}よかったと{と|to-quote}思[おも]います。
issues.problem: Quotative と appeared twice (a literal と plus the slot), which is ungrammatical.
issues.action: Removed the literal と before the slot.

issues.jp_before: 薬[くすり]{を|o-object}{のめば/のんだら|ba-conditional}よかったです。
issues.problem: Fourth ばよかった regret item in the file, a near-duplicate of the pattern.
issues.action: Rewrote it as a ばいいですか question (洗濯機はどのボタンを押せばいいですか) with distractor おすなら.

issues.jp_before: 玄関[げんかん]{の|no-possessive}ドア{を|o-object}{あけると/あけたら|to-conditional}、猫[ねこ]{が|ga-subject}座[すわ]っていました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the window and box 'opened it and found...' discovery items (third あける discovery).
issues.action: Rewrote it as a directions sentence (この道をまっすぐ行くと、右に郵便局があります) with alternatives いけば/いったら and distractor いくなら.

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}お酒[さけ]{を|o-object}{のむと/のんだら|to-conditional}、すぐ顔[かお]{が|ga-subject}赤[あか]くなります。

issues.action: Moved のめば into the alternatives, left なら as the only distractor, and updated why.
